personas.label: Business owners handling customers and suppliers
Consultants and freelancers working with clients

prompts.value: Do I need any technical experience?
prompts.answer: The AI Workshop: No coding, automation tools, or AI experience is required. If you can type a message and use a web browser, you can take part. We build step by step in the room.

prompts.value: Is this useful if I do not run a business?
prompts.answer: The AI Workshop: Yes. Professionals can use meeting or project notes; business owners can use customer or supplier conversations; consultants can use client calls. Everyone builds the same notes-to-follow-up assistant with their own context.

prompts.value: What exactly will I build on 27 September?
prompts.answer: The AI Workshop: A reusable follow-up assistant, one reviewed recap with an action list and message draft, and a second test on new notes. You save it as a Gemini Gem or reusable instructions. This is one practical project, not a tour of AI tools.

prompts.value: How is this different from asking ChatGPT to write an email?
prompts.answer: The AI Workshop: You set up reusable instructions for your work, tone, and output format. You teach the assistant to separate facts from missing information, test it on two examples, and learn how to check the result. The goal is repeatable work, not one impressive answer.

prompts.value: Do I need a paid AI subscription?
prompts.answer: The AI Workshop: The session is designed around a free personal Google account and Gemini on the web. Features and usage limits can vary. If Gem creation is unavailable on your account, the same instructions work in a normal chat and can be saved in a document. No paid upgrade is required for the core exercise.

prompts.value: Can I attend with only a phone?
prompts.answer: The AI Workshop: A laptop is recommended for creating and testing your Gem in a browser. A phone can be used for the chat-and-saved-instructions version. Sign in to your Google account before you arrive and bring your charger.

prompts.value: Will it send WhatsApp messages or emails automatically?
prompts.answer: The AI Workshop: No. It creates drafts from notes you provide. It does not connect to your inbox, record calls, send messages, or chase people in the background. You check, edit, and send each message yourself.

prompts.value: Can I use confidential client or company information?
prompts.answer: The AI Workshop: Please do not bring private client, employee, patient, financial, or company data. Use anonymised notes you have permission to share, or our fictional samples. Follow your employer’s AI policy. Never record someone without their permission.

prompts.value: Do I need to have attended the June workshop?
prompts.answer: The AI Workshop: No. Each workshop stands on its own. Our first session in June 2026 was about building and hosting websites. September is a different project and starts from the basics.

prompts.value: Where is it, and what does the ticket include?
prompts.answer: The AI Workshop: The workshop is offline in Salt Lake, Kolkata, on Sunday 27 September 2026, 11:00 AM–2:00 PM. The ticket is ₹799 for the three-hour guided session and reusable instructions. There are 50 seats. The exact venue is shared after reservation; contact us before booking if you need to check travel or accessibility.
